method: Each actual existing PNG preview was viewed individually after proportional in-memory resize to at most 850x1200 pixels and JPEG quality 60. No source preview or PDF was changed.

pages.observation: Title, author, date and through-S4 exclusion are readable. Minor nonblocking subtitle widow: S4 alone on final line.
Scope and terminal completion paragraphs are readable, unclipped, and explicitly retain negative Push-T gate, mixed Walker results and regressed ordinary prediction errors.
Methods/control paragraphs fit. Composite safety, unresolved point-FSA and clustered-uncertainty caveats are clearly readable.
Recovered-bank source counts, fixed-size/no-variance-rationale caveat, failed stress costs and development-witness limitation are readable; no clipping.
Compact E1 attribution chart and adjacent caption clearly show 21/7/0 among 28 known false-safes, separate unresolved case and no overall point FSA. Supplement paths fit.
Representative E2 table is readable. Exact 4096-label denominator, fallback recipe, retained paid incomplete branches and undefined-FSA/unequal-acceptance note are adjacent.

Compact E2 bounds figure is readable. Bands are explicitly identification bounds rather than confidence intervals; caption states 2048 branches times two labels. Fixed-set bound and 80-px fallback limitations are visible.
Stress table and scope paragraph are readable and separate stress from independent replication. Minor nonblocking mid-word wrap of Acceptance header; rates/undefined values remain unambiguous.
Retention and cost tables are readable. Real-readout centre error, full-horizon counts versus goal-success counts, incomplete goal retention and scoped simulator totals are explicitly distinguished.

nonblocking_findings.issue: Cover subtitle wraps S4 onto its own final line.
Acceptance header wraps mid-word in narrow table column.

limitations: Visual/layout and nearby caveat review of pages 1-9 only; parent and another reviewer own pages 10-26.
This review uses raster previews, not an independent PDF renderer or full numerical re-audit.
Final delivery/publication acceptance is separate from visual approval.
